name_note: GTDB's s__Prevotella hominis is the species described as Prevotella hominis; the genomes in this taxon carry the NCBI name Segatella hominis after the reclassification of Prevotella into several genera.

sentences.text: Genomic comparison placed the strain as an independent lineage from Prevotella copri, its closest relative, with similarity values clearly below species delineation thresholds.
Acetate and succinate were produced from glucose as metabolic end products, and the predominant menaquinones were MK-11 and MK-12.
Species previously assigned to the genus Prevotella were later reclassified into seven genera, including four novel genera named Segatella, Hoylesella, Leyella and Palleniella.
